# International Journal of New Findings in Health and Educational Sciences (IJHES)

> IJHES is an open-access, peer-reviewed academic journal publishing research in health and educational sciences under Creative Commons licensing.

IJHES is published by ARVIN ARENA Scientific Research and Publishing Institute based in Izmir, Turkey. The journal provides a platform for researchers to share peer-reviewed findings in health and educational sciences through an open-access model with transparent editorial processes and author guidelines.
